description: This file defines the LoggerAppenderSocket class, which extends LoggerAppenderSkeleton, and facilitates sending serialized logging events or XML formatted events over a network socket to a remote host. It includes methods for creating, managing, and closing socket connections, and for formatting logging data according to configuration.

classes.name: LoggerAppenderSocket
classes.description: A class that serializes log events and transmits them to a network socket, supporting optional XML formatting and configurable connection parameters.

methods.name: LoggerAppenderSocket
methods.description: Constructor initializing the appender with a given name.

methods.name: activateOptions
methods.description: Establishes a socket connection to the configured remote host and port, initializes XML layout if needed.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the socket connection and marks the appender as closed.

methods.name: getLocationInfo
methods.description: Returns whether location info is included in logs.

methods.name: getLog4jNamespace
methods.description: Returns whether the log4j namespace is used in XML layout.

methods.name: getTimeout
methods.description: Returns the socket connection timeout value.

methods.name: getUseXml
methods.description: Returns whether XML layout is used for log formatting.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Closes current socket and resets the appender state.

methods.name: setHostname
methods.description: Deprecated. Sets the remote host address.

methods.name: setLocationInfo
methods.description: Configures whether location info should be included in log events.

methods.name: setLog4jNamespace
methods.description: Configures the use of log4j namespace in XML layout.

methods.name: setPort
methods.description: Sets the network port, ensuring it is within valid range.

methods.name: setUseXml
methods.description: Enables or disables XML formatting of logs.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Serializes and sends the logging event over the socket, formatted as XML or serialized object based on configuration.
